tagline: Mobile bike service — we come to you
description: Professional bike repairs and servicing at your home or workplace. Book a time, leave the bike out, and get back to riding.
highlights: No hauling your bike to a shop

services.name: Tune-up
services.description: Gears and brakes adjusted, chain cleaned and lubed, tyres pumped, bolts checked.

services.name: Full service
services.description: Everything in the tune-up plus drivetrain degrease, wheel truing and hub and headset check.

services.name: Puncture repair
services.description: Flat tyre fixed on the spot. New tube or tyre charged at cost if needed.

services.name: Brake service
services.description: Pads, cables or hydraulic bleed so you stop when you need to.

services.name: E-bike check
services.description: Tune-up plus motor, battery and electrical connections checked, with a firmware check where supported.

services.name: Something else
services.description: Not sure what's wrong? We'll diagnose it and quote before doing any work.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Leave the bike somewhere we can reach it (courtyard, bike shed, office) and tell us how to find it in the access notes. We'll message you when we're done.
Common parts like tubes, brake pads, cables and chains are in the van. They're charged at cost on top of the service price. We always ask before fitting anything over 200 kr.
Pay after the job by MobilePay or card. You get an itemised receipt by email.

faq.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faq.a: Yes. Use the link in your confirmation email to cancel or send us a message, or just reply to any of our emails.
